title: 一般现在时与一般过去时的被动语态

instructions: Read the Chinese explanations. Questions 1–8 are guided practice; questions 9–12 use the rules in new contexts.
passage:
1. 一般现在时被动语态使用 am / is / are + 过去分词，说明现在通常发生的事或一般安排。主语是被处理的人或事物；复数主语用 are。
例句：The drain is checked every month. The keys are provided to residents every year. The bulb is replaced when necessary. The routine checks are arranged by the office.

2. 一般过去时被动使用 was / were + 过去分词，说明过去某时已发生的处理。yesterday 或 last week 等已结束时间通常提示一般过去时。
例句：The lock was replaced yesterday. The keys were checked last week. The pipe was inspected on Monday. The curtains were moved yesterday.

3. 被动句否定在 be 后加 not；疑问句把 be 移到主语前。by 可以说明执行者，但若执行者不重要或未知，可以不写。
例句：The light was not replaced. Was the window inspected? The chair was repaired by a carpenter.
